user.title: Sungrow inverter
user.description: Starts in shadow mode: nothing is written to the inverter until you turn that off. Whenever it does write, it first saves the limit it found and puts that value back afterwards.

data.grid_export_negative: Grid sensor reports export as negative
data.enter_price: Start limiting at or below this price
data.exit_price: Stop limiting at or above this price
data.soc_export_w: Grid export needed to start when the battery is full
data.min_sun_elevation: Stop limiting below this sun elevation
data.restore_after_minutes: Put the original limit back after

data_description.price_entity: The price you are paid to export. A negative value means you pay to export.
data_description.grid_entity: Site grid power from a meter, in W or kW. The inverter itself has no meter, so this must come from another device.
data_description.grid_export_negative: On when exporting reads negative and importing positive (the usual meter convention). Turn off if it is the other way round.
data_description.load_entity: Whole-house consumption. The limit is never set below it. Leave empty to floor the limit at the minimum limit below, and set that to your typical load.
data_description.soc_entity: If set, a battery at or above the full level lets limiting start on a smaller export.
data_description.shadow_mode: On, the rule evaluates everything and reports what it would do (Target export limit sensor and the episode event) but writes nothing. Turn off to let it write the limit.
data_description.enter_price: In the price sensor's own unit.
data_description.exit_price: Must be above the start price. The gap stops flapping on a noisy price.
data_description.min_export_w: Limiting only starts while the site really exports at least this much.
data_description.soc_high: At or above this charge, limiting starts on the smaller export below.
data_description.soc_export_w: A full battery cannot absorb the surplus.
data_description.hold_seconds: The price and export conditions must both hold this long.
data_description.min_limit_kw: Never write a limit below this. Without a house load sensor it is the only floor.
data_description.deadband_w: Saves needless writes to the inverter.
data_description.max_hours: Limiting stops after this long, restores the original limit and waits for the conditions to clear before it can start again.
data_description.stale_seconds: If the price, grid, load or battery reading is older than this, limiting ends and the original limit is put back.
data_description.min_sun_elevation: Puts the original limit back before the light ends and the dongle powers off.
data_description.restore_after_minutes: A limit this integration lowered lapses back by itself unless the rule keeps renewing it. This is the watchdog.
data_description.host: The dongle's Modbus port is encrypted by the inverter itself and needs no login.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read the inverter through the dongle.
error.exit_price_not_above_enter_price: The stop price must be above the start price.

abort.already_configured: This dongle is already set up.
